messages:
maya: Hey team, hitting something odd on the browser quickstart...
maya: Followed the React sample, pasted API key, clicked "Run" and UI shows "Payment required" toast.
maya: But curl with the same key from my terminal returns 200 and a valid body.
liam: can you paste the network tab response? :mag:
maya: response headers + body below:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
x-edge-status: 402
x-proxy-workspace: user_abc123
{
  "id": "resp_01F...",
  "choices": [{"text":"hello"}]
}
```
devon: ah, the CDN/proxy is adding x-edge-status for routing and gating. UI checks that header, not the body. that explains it.
samir: @devops who owns the edge config that adds x-edge-status?
devops: that was added during the last gating rollout to help the edge send users to billing flow. we intended it for 4xx/5xx but i guess it leaked on 2xx.
maya: so the SDK/browser sees 200 body but UI logic interprets header as a 402 and shows payment modal. messy UX.
liam: short-term fix: update quickstart UI to trust the body.status or body.code for success, and ignore x-edge-status on 2xx. long-term: strip that header for browser origins.
devon: also the browser SDK retries when it sees the header as 402 which can cause duplicate requests. we should not retry on status headers for 2xx responses.
samir: on billing: did any of these attempts actually get billed? i.e., can bad retries cause chargeable usage?
devon: billing is attributed from the event payload id in the body. the server processed once and returned success; retries that didn't complete won't be billed. still, we should avoid extra work.
maya: i'm pushing a quick branch that strips x-edge-status for requests with Origin headers that match our quickstart domains. testing now.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: edge-config-279 -> 2 regions.
liam: thanks. please also add a short unit test in the UI that ignores x-edge-status for 2xx.
maya: added test + patch, running local QA.
devops: rolling the canary. will monitor errors and billing events.
may a: (typo) maya: verified in canary — quickstart now shows success and no erroneous payment modal. :tada:
samir: filed DOC-QUIK-842 to update docs and add a note in quickstart troubleshooting about header mismatches. assigning to devon.
liam: nice catch — good teamwork.
maya: thanks all, closing thread once canary is green.
